subject: english
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

Play your ace
solution: The correct answer is: **Use your best resource**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The phrase **"Play your ace"** means to use your best resource or the most effective strategy you have. (अपना सबसे अच्छा संसाधन या सबसे प्रभावी रणनीति का उपयोग करना) • **Example: **When negotiations were failing, she decided to play her ace and revealed the secret information she had. • **"Use your best resource"** refers to utilizing the most valuable or effective tool, skill, or piece of information you have. (अपने सबसे मूल्यवान या प्रभावी उपकरण, कौशल, या जानकारी का उपयोग करना) • **Example: **In the final round of the competition, he played his ace by showcasing his unique talent. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.** 39:Tc63, The correct answer is: **Option 3.**
